description: Villagers have a protruding 2x4x2 nose centered on the face. The mouth must be placed BELOW the nose tip, not at the standard player mouth position. Illagers share the same head geometry.

mouth_attachment.fitting_notes: ty lowered to clear the nose bottom. tz pushed forward to sit in front of the nose base. sx/sy slightly reduced so the mouth aperture sits within the chin area.

mob_specific_notes.villager: Arms are folded (crossed) by default. Talking gestures should use a subtle unfolding motion or stay Off to avoid breaking the iconic pose.
mob_specific_notes.pillager: Arms hold a crossbow. Use Off gestures unless the character is unarmed.
mob_specific_notes.vindicator: Holds an axe. Same arm caution as pillager.

notes: The nose protrusion is the main fitting challenge. Each villager profession uses a different hat/overlay but the face geometry is identical. Preset values are approximate; the user should preview and fine-tune ty/tz in the fitting wizard.
